about_text: I'm Hev, a tattoo artist and illustrator based in Marietta, Georgia. My work ranges from colorful, playful designs to darker illustrative pieces. Explore my tattoos and other artwork below.
booking_description: Tell me about your idea using the consultation form below. Consultations are free, and preferred dates are not guaranteed. Appointment deposits are collected through Divine Rites Tattoo only after booking is confirmed.
